main.title: <:league_medal:949137422933962753> CWL Time <:league_medal:949137422933962753>
main.body:
Below are the CWL Rosters. Once your attacks are complete, make your way to your assigned Clan.

Open My assignments below to see your published clan and its join link. You can also find them in <#1114047624216068136>

Direct all questions and concerns to <#801950200133976124> <:warriorcat:947992348971905035>

lazy.title: <:league_medal:949137422933962753> Lazy CWL Time <:league_medal:949137422933962753>
lazy.body:
Below are the Lazy CWL Rosters. If you cannot view the Roster or do not understand it, please ping <@&769130325460254740> in <#872692009066958879> and we'll get it sorted.

As soon as both your attacks are complete in the current war make your way to your assigned Clan. __The sooner the better.__

There are several Bots in the server that can provide war information. To many to list here. Feel free to play around in <#1128848663872028743>. War and CWL are good keywords for looking.

old_stored_body:
Below are the two signup forms required to participate here in Warriors United CWL. LazyCWL is an option for all within the Family but if your in one of our FWA Clans it's "Lazy Way or No Way".

The forms take less then a couple minutes to complete and the sooner you sign up the better it is on us making Rosters.

Direct all questions and concerns to <#801950200133976124> <:warriorcat:947992348971905035>
